description: Automerge non-major dependency updates, major updates of the actions GitHub publishes, and major updates of the official node image in a Dockerfile to an even-numbered release, after required checks pass

Automerge major updates of the actions GitHub publishes under actions/* and github/*; a PR-triggered workflow runs every action it uses, and their majors are mostly runtime moves such as a Node.js bump

Automerge major updates of the official node image in a Dockerfile to an even-numbered release, the lines that become LTS; the Dockerfile builds in the PR checks, so a green PR has built with the new Node.js. Keep before the Alpine rule, which leaves a move to Alpine 4 for review
Leave a move from Alpine 3 to a newer Alpine major for review; the Alpine rules in the inherited config classify it as a patch update
